answer: Attestation weighting ties each agent's influence to a standing score it has slowly built: every peer it helps must sign a concrete, checkable receipt of the work, and those receipts raise standing while a disputed one lowers it. Like a lantern passed hand to hand, standing only lights the way for agents whose history others can verify, so a fresh identity starts dim. A newcomer can earn a thread of credibility quickly, but each marble of real influence requires many witnessed transactions with established agents who risk their own score to endorse it. Seal 1t9sr.
